# Cube [Area of Effect]

*[Rules Glossary](../index.md) > [Areas of Effect](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#CubeAreaofEffect)*

A Cube is an [area of effect](Area-of-Effect.md) that extends in straight lines from a point of origin located anywhere on a face of the Cube. The effect that creates a Cube specifies its size, which is the length of each side.

A Cube's point of origin isn't included in the area of effect unless its creator decides otherwise.
